title: Locally closed locus where degree-zero pullback cohomology is finite locally free
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E$ be a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] in the derived category [def-pc-derived-category] on $S$ of tor-amplitude in an interval $[a,b]$. For every integer $r\ge0$ there is an immersion $j:Z\to S$ of finite presentation such that, for every morphism $h:T\to S$, the map $h$ factors through $Z$ if and only if for every further morphism $u:T'\to T$ the module $H^a(L(h\circ u)^*E)$ is finite locally free [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] of rank $r$; on $Z$, this cohomology module is finite locally free of rank $r$ and is compatible with pullback.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma locally-closed-where-H0-locally-free, Tag 0BDL

proof.text: Apply the rank-bound open lemma to obtain U, its quasi-compact inclusion, and factorization of all maps satisfying universal lowest-rank freeness. Apply the closed-matrix-locus lemma on U using its bound beta_a <= r. Put j = i followed by the open inclusion. A closed immersion and an open immersion compose to an immersion; local finite presentation and quasi-compactness are preserved by composition (Mathlib instances IsImmersion.comp, locallyOfFinitePresentation_comp, quasiCompact_comp).

If h = g followed by j, for every further map v apply the single-pullback matrix-locus criterion to (v followed by g) followed by i, with the exhibited factorization v followed by g. Associativity identifies its cohomology with the test for v followed by h. Conversely, universal freeness makes h factor through U; specialize the universal condition to the identity of its source and apply the single-pullback matrix-locus criterion. Compose its lift with the open inclusion to obtain h.

The identity of Z factors through j. The proved universal criterion therefore supplies universal lowest-rank freeness along j. Specializing to the identity of Z gives the required finite locally free cohomology on Z. Apply the universal lowest-cohomology pullback lemma to this universal condition for each g:T->Z to get the final isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem exists_perfectLowestCohomologyLocus [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))] (S : Scheme.{u}) [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hE : IsPerfect S E) (a b : ℤ) (hamp : ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace), ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S E F i) (r : ℕ) : ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z ⟶ S), IsImmersion j ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation j ∧ QuasiCompact j ∧ (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S), (∃ g : T ⟶ Z, g ≫ j = h) ↔ ∀ (T' : Scheme.{u}) (u' : T' ⟶ T), SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj ((derivedPullback (u' ≫ h)).obj E)) r) ∧ SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) a).obj ((derivedPullback j).obj E)) r ∧ (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ Z), Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback g).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) a).obj ((derivedPullback j).obj E)) ≅ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj ((derivedPullback (g ≫ j)).obj E)))
